summary: Recheck advanced retry permission on every checkpoint manifest page

replay.detail: Envelope receipt, duplicate handling, projection and replay are unchanged.

schema.detail: No durable table, index or data-format changes; retry credit is private task-local state.

rules.detail: No claim or checkpoint rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Public and ordinary checkpoint fetching preserve their existing behavior. Advanced retry submission checks now also cover every manifest page; a full exchange may include compact, follow-up, overload polls and manifest pagination. The permission bounds one exchange opportunity, not its total POST count.

downtime.detail: No migration or additional service interruption beyond a normal binary swap.

manual.detail: No new configuration or manual action.

recovery.detail: An advanced exchange carries admission through checkpoint need and every page submission. Changed authority, routes, removal or monotonic expiry stops further pages without imposing an adoption-failure cooldown. Ordinary checkpoint authentication, certificate validation and adoption remain intact. Source-only draft; no recovery or performance qualification.
